text:
I got my braces done here.
From the pre-treatment preparation,
scaling, fillings, the dentist is gentle and speaks kindly.
I've had braces for less than a year and my teeth are already aligned.
I consulted with other clinics and they said it would take 2 years.
The counter staff and assistants are all lovely and attentive.
Damn, the staff never told me the price before adding up the bill, it was wrong. The doctor was showing off his intelligence.
The dentist is kind and has a very gentle touch. The clinic is beautiful and clean.

author_name: อดิศร จิรสุวรรณกุล
